name: Fixture Scheme Stable
description: A tier fixture: a Stable color scheme, cool slate with a blue accent and a teal secondary, in light and dark, for the quality gates to run as a shipping Stable pack.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from cool slate anchors in light and dark.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v1 derives from each base set, and print renders the light set.
caveats: A test fixture: it registers only when QUALITY_FIXTURES is 1 or meta.
